responsible.hint: Identify the source of harm and the matching control; documenting a risk, preventing it, detecting it, and requiring human approval are distinct safeguards.

responsible-01.label: Existing social or institutional inequality is reflected in the data used to build the system.
responsible-01.why: Existing social or institutional inequality is reflected in the data used to build the system.

responsible-02.label: Some people, conditions, languages, or cases are underrepresented in the dataset.
responsible-02.why: Some people, conditions, languages, or cases are underrepresented in the dataset.

responsible-03.label: The chosen feature or label is an imperfect and systematically distorted proxy for the real concept.
responsible-03.why: The chosen feature or label is an imperfect and systematically distorted proxy for the real concept.

responsible-04.label: Evaluates whether system quality and harms are acceptably distributed across relevant groups.
responsible-04.why: Evaluates whether system quality and harms are acceptably distributed across relevant groups.

responsible-05.label: Helps people understand the factors or evidence contributing to a model output.
responsible-05.why: Helps people understand the factors or evidence contributing to a model output.

responsible-06.label: Communicates that AI is being used, its intended purpose, limitations, and accountable owner.
responsible-06.why: Communicates that AI is being used, its intended purpose, limitations, and accountable owner.

responsible-07.label: Places qualified people in review or approval paths for uncertain, sensitive, or consequential cases.
responsible-07.why: Places qualified people in review or approval paths for uncertain, sensitive, or consequential cases.

responsible-08.label: Records where content came from and whether it was generated or modified by AI.
responsible-08.why: Records where content came from and whether it was generated or modified by AI.

responsible-09.label: Detects and removes personal data before it reaches a model, log, or unauthorized recipient.
responsible-09.why: Detects and removes personal data before it reaches a model, log, or unauthorized recipient.

responsible-10.label: Gives a model, agent, or tool only the permissions required for its specific task.
responsible-10.why: Gives a model, agent, or tool only the permissions required for its specific task.

responsible-11.label: Untrusted instructions in user input or retrieved content attempt to redirect model behavior.
responsible-11.why: Untrusted instructions in user input or retrieved content attempt to redirect model behavior.

responsible-12.label: Malicious instructions hidden in external content are retrieved or read by an AI system.
responsible-12.why: Malicious instructions hidden in external content are retrieved or read by an AI system.

responsible-13.label: Input is crafted to evade behavioral safeguards and elicit prohibited output.
responsible-13.why: Input is crafted to evade behavioral safeguards and elicit prohibited output.

responsible-14.label: Manipulated training examples introduce attacker-chosen behavior or systematic errors.
responsible-14.why: Manipulated training examples introduce attacker-chosen behavior or systematic errors.

responsible-15.label: Malicious or misleading documents are inserted into a knowledge source to corrupt grounded answers.
responsible-15.why: Malicious or misleading documents are inserted into a knowledge source to corrupt grounded answers.

responsible-16.label: The system reveals confidential information through output, logs, memory, or tool results.
responsible-16.why: The system reveals confidential information through output, logs, memory, or tool results.

responsible-17.label: An agent can take consequential actions without adequate scope limits, confirmation, or supervision.
responsible-17.why: An agent can take consequential actions without adequate scope limits, confirmation, or supervision.

responsible-18.label: Abusive requests trigger excessive model or tool consumption and create avoidable cost.
responsible-18.why: Abusive requests trigger excessive model or tool consumption and create avoidable cost.

responsible-19.label: Documents intended use, evaluation results, limitations, risks, and other facts about a model.
responsible-19.why: Documents intended use, evaluation results, limitations, risks, and other facts about a model.

responsible-20.label: Records prompts, model versions, retrieved evidence, tool actions, approvals, and outcomes for accountability.
responsible-20.why: Records prompts, model versions, retrieved evidence, tool actions, approvals, and outcomes for accountability.
